text:
mira: Heads-up — intake for a customer special request. They want an instruct-tuned variant of our 32B base with 64k context, int4 quantized if possible. Main asks: match current instruct behavior, no regression on safety/hallucination, and keep p95 latency < 450ms.

tyler: Noted. What's the source model / tuning recipe? any existing prompt templates from the customer?

mira: Customer used an in-house instruction-tune on top of our upstream. They shared a small eval set (~2k prompts) and a list of failure cases. Also want streaming enabled.

sam: Important checklist items:
- run baseline eval on float16 instruct (current prod variant)
- run int8 and int4 quant experiments (with two PTQ configs)
- compare per-task metrics and regressed prompts
- latency/throughput vs our SLOs

jen_qe: I'll own the regression sensitivity tests. Plan: run the customer eval set + our standard safety/prompt-injection suite. Quick plan:
1) smoke: 100 sample subset through float32 float16 int8 int4 to catch large diffs
2) focused: run the full 2k set and flag any >5% drop in exact-match / nli pass rates
3) hallucination probe: use targeted hallucination prompts + TruthfulQA subset

mira: Good. Also need to validate long-context behavior: KV cache correctness, attention window edge cases, and chunked prompts.

sam: For long ctx, add these checks:
- rolling-prefix test (append short queries to reach 64k)
- attention-offset stability (rollover points)
- memory/perf: GPU memory profile for kv cache at 64k tokens

tyler: Ops constraints: int4 might need kernel support and our runtime fallback plan. If int4 path misses some ops, we should have automatic fallback to int8 for those kernels. Also quantify cost delta.

mira: Can someone draft the intake priority and timeline? Customer expects a proof-of-concept in 2 weeks, production rollout in ~8 weeks if no regressions.

pm_elaine: From PM: Priority is medium-high. Proof-of-concept = go/no-go for quantization + long ctx. Deliverables: demo + regression report + perf profile. I'll coordinate customer comms.

tyler: I'll schedule a dedicated GPU pool for experiments (requesting 2x A100-80GB or equivalent). ops-bot, please reserve?

ops-bot: @tyler reservation queued: 2x A100-80GB for experiment window 2026-03-18 to 2026-03-25. Confirm with infra team if size needs adjustment.

sam: Example eval command I'll run (local harness):
```
python eval_harness/run_eval.py \
  --model variant/edge-instruct-32b:f16 \
  --eval-set customer/edge_instruct_eval.jsonl \
  --metrics rouge,exact_match,factuality \
  --output results/f16_baseline.json
```
I'll iterate for `:int8` and `:int4` tags and produce delta tables.

jen_qe: For automated regression alerts, set thresholds: overall quality drop >3% OR any single prompt with >15% output diffs flagged for human review. I'll add an eval job in CI.

mira: Also need to prepare A/B configs: online canary at 5% traffic, with automatic rollback on safety regressions. Create a rollout policy in Console:
- canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%
- fail if safety alert OR latency p95 > 550ms for more than 10 minutes

tyler: Noted. Will add model variant metadata: base+instruct-tune hash, quant config, build date, supported ctx=64k, streaming=on.

pm_elaine: ETA for draft plan (including experiment matrix, owners, and customer-facing timeline)?

mira: I'll put initial plan in a google doc by EOD today and tag owners.

jen_qe: I'll start the smoke tests tomorrow morning and post a CSV of failures here.

sam: If int4 shows widespread regressions, plan B: int8 quant + compiler kernel optimizations + cost analysis.

mira: Great — next sync Friday. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
